name: Louis Riel
bio: Louis Riel, the Métis leader of the 1885 North-West Rebellion in Canada, was followed closely by the Cow Boy from March 1885. The paper blamed the Dominion government's handling of land claims, called the rebels' demands just, and also reported that Riel had a reputation as two-faced. It reported the fighting at Batoche in May, his capture later that month, his conviction and repeated reprieves that fall, and his execution at Regina in November 1885. In December it reported fears of a new outbreak over his death.

moments.label: Reported the rebellion Riel led in Saskatchewan
